verdict.rationale: treg is built API-first: one base URL and token expose 159 documented operations plus a proxy to 3,800+ provider endpoints, and a probe confirms a live OpenAPI spec. The same surface is reachable through a CLI (tool listing, credential health, reviews, feedback, CLI uploads) and an MCP endpoint (balance, review), and llms.txt teaches agents the whole protocol. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or audit that every UI action (e.g., team member permissions, invites, billing top-up) is available via API, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
